targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the most recent process start; a drop means a restart or deploy.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4..", status_code!="499"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status_code="499"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (route) topk(10, sum by (route) (increase(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))))

sum by (method) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (method) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Requests slower than 1s / s

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", le="1.0"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Request rate above the 1s bucket boundary, by route.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))))
topk(15, sum by (route, status_code) (increase(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: file/*path non-307 ratio
panels.description: A healthy file read answers 307 to the worker; anything else is an auth, key or signing failure.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~".*/file/\\*path", status_code!="307"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~".*/file/\\*path"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Storage requests / s by route and status
file/*path by attempt
panels.description: first = initial load; retry = Annotator auto / manual retry; probe = worker probe sent after the retry also failed (≈ a viewer stuck on the error overlay). Needs the storage_file_requests_total metric (apps/api).

panels.title: Retry ratio
panels.description: (retry + probe) / first: how often a first load needs another try.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(storage_file_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", attempt!="first"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(storage_file_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", attempt="first"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Failed after retry (range)
panels.description: Probe requests: the retry failed too, so the ui probed the worker before reporting to Sentry.

panels.title: Retries and probes by route / status

targets.expr: sum by (route, attempt, status_code) (increase(storage_file_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", attempt!="first"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Upload API req/s
panels.description: Presign, upload-token and commit calls. The bytes go browser → R2 or browser → upload worker and never reach apps/api.

panels.title: Upload API failure ratio
panels.description: 4xx (namespace / MIME / size rejected, no permission) + 5xx, out of all upload API calls.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~".*/(storage/presign|upload-token|upload-zip/token|drop-publish/commit|flat-zip/commit|import-archive)", status_code=~"4..|5..", status_code!="499"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~".*/(storage/presign|upload-token|upload-zip/token|drop-publish/commit|flat-zip/commit|import-archive)"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)
